name: Lauki Chana Dal
instructions: 1. Soak the chana dal for at least 30 minutes. 2. In a pressure cooker, add the dal, diced lauki, turmeric, salt, and water, then cook for 3-4 whistles. 3. Heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes, then add cumin seeds, hing, and curry leaves. 4. Add onions and sauté until translucent, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. 5. Add tomatoes and powdered spices, cooking until the oil separates. 6. Pour the cooked dal mixture into the pan, simmer for 5-7 minutes, and garnish with fresh coriander.
description: Lauki Chana Dal is a staple home-cooked meal in Chhattisgarh, reflecting the state's reliance on simple, nutritious, and locally available produce. It is typically served with steamed rice or 'bidi' roti, offering a perfect balance of fiber and protein.
